name: prelisted_research_questions
description: 正文未以RQ或hypothesis清单预注册研究问题；贡献清单列产物而非可判定假设。

name: benchmark_hierarchy
description: 10 main categories × 5 subcategories × 7 scenarios × 3 prompt variations = 1,050 prompts；分Fundamental、Composite、Anti-Physics三层。

name: prompt_creation
description: GPT-4o/Gemini各生成20个Event Prompts，人工选7个；Physics-Enhanced由人工写，Detailed由LLM生成后人工核验。

name: evaluation_targets
description: 12个生成模型，每个模型1050 videos，共12,600 outputs；5个proprietary、7个open-source。

name: binary_outcome_definition
description: SA要求对象数量与事件均满足；PC要求所有Key Standards满足；Both为SA=1且PC=1。

name: human_evaluation
description: MTurk每个video由3名独立标注者评估，majority vote；报酬18 USD/hour。

name: automatic_evaluation
description: CAP均匀抽取8帧，先描述object/event/physics，再结构化Yes/No；主实验使用GPT-o1并以human labels评ROC-AUC。

name: automatic_baselines
description: 自动评估基线为Qwen-VL-2.0、Gemini-2.0-Flash、GPT-4o、GPT-o1，并做去CoT/去Context消融。

name: prompt_type_control
description: prompt variation效应只在开源模型上分析，因为proprietary refinement不可核验。

name: paired_failure_tests
description: abrupt/non-abrupt与complex/less-complex各使用20对提示×12模型=240 videos，只做人类正确性判断。

name: implementation_sources
description: 附录列7个开源模型的repo/license，闭源模型访问方式及Luma API。
evidence_sections: E Model Application Details|E Model Application Details

name: video_duration
description: 11个模型为5秒，Open-Sora为2秒，Step-Video-T2V为8秒。

name: random_seeds
description: 正文与附录均未报告generator seed、CAP sampling seed或标注抽样seed。

name: hardware
description: 生成、CAP推理与fine-tuning均未报告硬件。

name: full_generation_budget
description: 仅零散给出Hunyuan/Wanx生成时间和Open-Sora sampling steps，未给12模型统一预算与关键超参数。

name: data_leakage_control
description: 没有测试benchmark prompts或场景是否进入各生成模型训练数据，也未提供去重/污染检查。

name: statistical_uncertainty
description: 主结果报告比例、ROC-AUC、precision/recall与差值，但无区间、假设检验、bootstrap或多重比较处理。

name: prelisted_research_questions
description: No numbered RQ or hypothesis list; §6 headings retrospectively organize performance, data-mixture transfer, and harness adaptation.

name: datasets
description: 13 sources spanning coding, software engineering, API/tool use, and web browsing; raw collection exceeds 1.3M instances.

name: effective_training_scale
description: After sampling and domain filtering, OpenHands/SWE-Agent use about 30K non-web examples and AgentLab about 20K web examples.

name: base_models
description: Main tables use Qwen2.5-Coder-Instruct at 7B, 14B, and 32B; transfer/equal-scale comparisons also use Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Qwen-3-8B.

name: agent_harnesses
description: OpenHands CodeActAgent, AgentLab, and SWE-Agent provide three distinct action/interface environments.

name: benchmarks
description: SWE-Bench Verified, WebArena, AgentBench OS, and GAIA; availability of evaluation code and agent specialization guide selection.

name: metric
description: All main benchmark tables report Accuracy point estimates.

name: sampling_weights
description: Per-dataset multiplier w_d controls up/downsampling; the union is shuffled each epoch.

name: random_seed
description: A fixed seed is stated, but its value and number of repeated runs are not reported.

name: domain_filtering
description: Coding/SWE harnesses exclude web datasets; AgentLab excludes coding/SWE datasets.

name: sft_implementation
description: All models are fine-tuned with the same LLaMA-Factory SFT pipeline.

name: training_hyperparameters
description: Learning rate, optimizer, batch size, context length, epoch/step count, scheduler, and checkpoint selection are absent from the PDF.

name: training_budget
description: Training tokens, steps, wall time, and compute budget are not reported.

name: hardware
description: Acknowledgement names the CMU FLAME Center but gives no accelerator or node configuration.

name: matched_controls
description: Table 6 holds harness+model fixed; Table 10 matches approximate sample count at 30K.

name: data_leakage_control
description: No benchmark contamination, repository overlap, or training/evaluation leakage audit is described.

name: failure_criterion
description: No failed-run, invalid-trajectory, or conversion-failure denominator is reported.

name: human_evaluation
description: The evaluation consists of automated benchmark accuracy; no human study is claimed.

name: task_definition
description: 3.1 distinguishes qualitative relational tasks from quantitative spatially-grounded tasks; §5.1 evaluates single-frame 3D detection, video 3D detection, and video 3D visual grounding.

name: spatially_grounded_training_corpus
description: The mixed corpus contains ScanNet, ARKitScenes, Matterport3D, 3RScan, SUN RGB-D, Objectron, ScanRefer, and Scan2Cap.

name: general_reasoning_training_corpus
description: General spatial reasoning training combines the LLaVA-Hound split of LLaVA-Video-178k, SPAR, and the curated spatially-grounded collection.

name: baselines
description: Cross-camera comparisons use Qwen2.5-VL and VG-LLM as task-finetuned baselines; the text says Gemini-2.5 fails 3D localization.

name: cross_camera_perturbation
description: All models train on full mixed-source data and are evaluated on ScanNet validation with synthetically resized images to perturb intrinsics; Figure 6 spans rescale factors 0.5–1.5.

name: ablation_setup
description: Ablation uses single-frame ScanNet 3D detection on ScanNet-val x1.2, created by rescaling and centrally cropping images; Table 5 reports 20 common classes.

name: qualitative_real_camera_case
description: Figure 7 adds unseen in-the-wild TUM-RGBD examples, but the paper presents them qualitatively.

name: training_recipe
description: Appendix B states one epoch, Adam, warmup ratio 0.03, learning rate up to 1e-5 then decay, total batch size 64, and 8 H100 80G GPUs.

name: frozen_trainable_modules
description: Qwen2.5-VL visual encoder, VGGT, and UniDepth v2 are frozen; MLLM, camera ray embedding, and geometric-prior distillator are trainable.

name: random_seeds
description: No random seeds are listed.

name: sample_counts_and_splits
description: Dataset names are given, but sample counts, sampling ratios, and complete train/validation/test split tables are absent.

name: data_leakage_control
description: No cross-dataset overlap, pretraining de-duplication, or test-image leakage control is stated.

name: objective_and_loss
description: The PDF does not specify a training loss, loss weights, or objective beyond the task outputs and frozen/trainable modules.

name: failure_rule_and_statistical_tests
description: The paper reports benchmark scores and curves but no failure threshold, hypothesis test, multiple-comparison correction, or seed-wise uncertainty.

name: data extraction and training pairs
description: Mathlib theorem proofs produce 469,965 states, 206,005 theorem proofs, 265,348 filtered premises, and 5,817,740 state-premise pairs; average relevant-premise count is 12.45.

name: hold-out and external benchmark
description: The paper randomly holds out 500 valid and 500 test theorems, then evaluates Mathlib hold-outs and non-Mathlib miniCTX-v2-test splits.

name: model variants
description: small, medium, and large encoder-only models use MiniLM-L6, MiniLM-L12, and DistilRoBERTa-base-derived configurations; Table 2 gives 23M, 33M, and 82M parameters.

name: training hyperparameters and compute
description: Learning rate is 2e−4, B=256, B−=3 from a hyperparameter sweep; large-model training requires 6.5 A6000-days.

name: retrieval and execution budgets
description: Full uses k1=16 for Lean-auto and k2=32 for premise applications; other variants use k=16 or k=32; Zipperposition has 10 seconds, each theorem 300 seconds wall-clock, and Lean heartbeat 200,000.

name: software and hardware
description: All extraction and experiments use Lean v4.16.0, up to 16 parallel tests on 16 CPUs and 512GB total memory, with AMD EPYC 9354 or similar CPUs.

name: metrics and aggregation
description: recall@k is the average percentage of ground-truth premises in top-k; proof rate is the percentage of theorems proved. Runtime is reported as mean seconds for Mathlib-test.

name: comparison controls
description: The study compares None, random forest, MePo, ReProver, three LeanPremise sizes, cumulative/union selectors, and Ground truth; random forest is explicitly an upper bound and ReProver has a definition footnote.

name: predeclared research questions
description: The paper does not list predeclared research questions or hypotheses; §4.1 moves directly from data and model setup to evaluation targets.

name: random seeds and uncertainty
description: No random seed list, repeated-run dispersion, confidence interval, hypothesis test, or error bar is reported in the PDF.

name: leakage and split audit
description: A random 500/500 hold-out is stated, but the PDF does not provide a train/test deduplication or leakage audit.

name: reproducible implementation release
description: The Reproducibility Statement says extraction, training, evaluation, API, data, models, and baselines are released, while the PDF does not give a full run command sequence.

name: predeclared_research_questions
description: No numbered RQ, preregistered hypothesis, or decision rule is stated; §4 moves directly from tasks to metrics and scale.

name: tasks_and_datasets
description: Six main generation tasks: Code (HumanEval/LiveCodeBench), Database (Spider), Actions (BFCL), Math (GSM8K), Data-to-Text (ToTTo), Summary (Summary of a Haystack).

name: instruction_count
description: Approximately 90-120 sharded instructions per task; task-specific appendix reports 100 Code, 107 Database, 105 Actions, 103 Math, 120 Data-to-Text, and 92 Summary.

name: model_scope
description: 15 LLMs from eight families, spanning small/large, open/closed, and two reasoning models.

name: matched_conditions
description: FULL, CONCAT, and SHARDED reuse the same underlying tasks; CONCAT controls for shard rephrasing while removing multi-turn disclosure.

name: simulation_repetition
description: Ten runs per model-instruction-simulation-type pair in the main experiment; more than 200,000 conversations total.

name: aggregation_and_denominator
description: P, A, and U are computed per instruction and then averaged over a corpus; task scores are normalized to 0-100.

name: metrics
description: P is mean task score; A is the per-instruction 90th percentile; U is the 90th-minus-10th percentile range. Task evaluators include functional accuracy, semantic equivalence, exact match, BLEU, and Joint Score.

name: answer_attempt_scoring
description: A SHARDED conversation receives the maximum score across per-turn answer attempts, giving it more chances than single-turn baselines.

name: random_seeds
description: The main simulation reports independent stochastic repetitions but no seed values or seed schedule.

name: training_budget
description: The work evaluates existing LLMs and does not train a model.

name: inference_budget
description: Estimated total API cost is about $5,000; all tasks use under 20k context tokens, most under 8k.

name: hyperparameters
description: Main experiments use temperature 1.0 and default remaining hyperparameters; response cap 1,000 tokens, increased to 10,000 for o3 and Deepseek-R1.

name: physical_hardware
description: Model providers and local Ollama access are listed, but CPU/GPU hardware is not specified.

name: implementation_sources
description: Appendix J identifies benchmark sources and reuses official or maintained evaluators; the paper states code/data will be released upon acceptance.

name: data_leakage_control
description: No explicit contamination audit is reported. The authors acknowledge that an early correct guess could reflect benchmark memorization.

name: failure_criteria
description: Task-specific success is defined by official evaluators; invalid SQL/code or semantic mismatch yields zero, while refinement tasks use continuous metrics.

name: simulator_validation
description: Manual inspection evaluates shard reveal/contextualization, strategy labels, extraction, and overall validity; the prose and table disagree on inspected conversation count.

name: formal_statistical_inference
description: The paper reports means and empirical percentiles but no estimator intervals, hypothesis-test specification, or multiple-comparison procedure.

name: supplementary_experiments
description: Gradual sharding, RECAP/SNOWBALL, system-prompt hinting, temperature, and translation experiments probe granularity, mitigations, and scope.

description: 引言用 prose 提出 succinctness lens，没有编号研究问题或假设。

name: training budget and hyperparameters
description: 没有训练过程。

name: hardware
description: 没有运行时实验或硬件报告。

name: implementation source
description: 论文提供数学构造与证明，没有软件实现。

name: controls and leakage
description: 没有数据采样、匹配或泄漏边界。

name: formal failure criterion
description: non-emptiness、equivalence 与 tiling-solution iff 是明确的判定标准。
